description: This file defines types, functions, and classes related to ARIA (Accessible Rich Internet Applications) snapshot parsing and comparison, including YAML parsing, ARIA node structures, and node comparison utilities.

classes.name: KeyParser
classes.description: Parser class for interpreting role and attribute keys in ARIA snapshot YAML.

classes.name: ParserError
classes.description: Custom error class for parsing errors with position info.

methods.name: ariaNodesEqual
methods.description: Compares two ARIA nodes for equality based on role, name, properties, and cursor.

methods.name: hasPointerCursor
methods.description: Checks if an ARIA node's box has a cursor set to 'pointer'.

methods.name: parseAriaSnapshotUnsafe
methods.description: Parses an ARIA snapshot YAML string into an ARIA node, throwing on errors.

methods.name: parseAriaSnapshot
methods.description: Parses an ARIA snapshot YAML string into an ARIA node, returning errors if any.

methods.name: findNewNode
methods.description: Finds a new ARIA node in 'to' that is not present in 'from', based on role and name.
